about.description:
Currently enrolled in a Bachelor’s degree in Systems, Networks & Cybersecurity at MyDigitalSchool Angers, I am looking for a one-year apprenticeship to put my skills in systems, networks and security into practice, while keeping a strong focus on product and development.

My background as a full-stack web developer, combined with my experience at 42 in Bangkok, has given me solid technical foundations, real discipline and a pragmatic approach to problem-solving. Two years spent in Cambodia taught me to adapt quickly, collaborate in diverse environments and remain effective in demanding contexts.

What I am looking for today is to join a team where I can make a concrete contribution to infrastructure, reliability and system security, while continuing to build useful, long-lasting tools and products.
